capabilities: Render a Gantt timeline from a task file via a taskscape code block
Show a grouped summary of recurring tasks with counts and date ranges
Filter tasks by date range and last-N count
Infer task states (pending, on-time, postponed, cancelled) from done, due and cancel dates
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. It makes no network requests and reads only the task file named in the code block. Only top-level task lines are read; nested sub-tasks are ignored. Grouping similar task names is beta and off by default.
problem: Obsidian shows task lists as plain text, with no visual way to see when tasks were due, done, postponed, or how long they stayed open.

relations.evidence: the emoji task format used by the Tasks plugin

summary: Code-block renderer that turns Markdown task lists into interactive Gantt timelines or grouped summaries inside notes.
